reviews.text:
We took Vahúr to Dani's place for a family vacation. We spent a few days at daycare before that so he could get used to the place because he had never been away from us before.
I can recommend it to everyone with all my heart because Dani really cares about the animals there, he is attentive, reliable, and it seems like he really does it from the heart.
We can thank Dani for the fact that Vahúr is still with us because he noticed something was wrong and took him to the doctor immediately.

"We are happy to take on any dog!"
This is what they write on the website. In comparison, they rejected my 7-month-old mixed breed dog outright because it also contains a Staffy. They didn't even offer a daycare or a trial day, they rejected it outright. My dog ​​is a shelter, non-traumatized mixed breed dog, well-socialized, well-intentioned, smart, high-energy adolescent dog. He is a regular visitor to doggy daycare, has been to a dog boarding school several times, and receives consistent boundary-setting education. However, they were not interested in this at all. It's a big disappointment, because based on the introduction on the website, Dani gave the impression of a very open and professional person.
I would be happy if they updated the website, because the principles stated do not match their practice.
You could also call it a dog hotel.

I dare to recommend the place! My dog ​​spent 6 nights at the guesthouse and I received a status report from him in picture or video form, and if I had any questions, I got a quick answer from them! On the last day, another owner mistakenly took our stuff, for which Dániel even went out to get it and brought my dog ​​home due to the "inconvenience", for which I feel great respect and gratitude. My dog, who has been spayed, returned home in good condition. My partner and I know for sure that the next time Bori needs a guesthouse, we will bring him here! Thank you for your work! ❤️🐾
The dog was in great shape, after a week of boarding, we even received pictures/videos while on vacation, the caretakers are kind, animal-friendly people, I recommend them!

Thank you very much for taking care of Lili, we could have a peaceful vacation because we knew she was in a good place. Everything was great, she came home in a good mood, I wholeheartedly recommend Dani's to everyone 🥰 …

I am very satisfied with Dani's. After neutering, they supervised my dog ​​and kept me constantly informed (even without asking), they took care of my dog, and helped him eat with extra treats. They also removed the stitches (they even struggled with my active dog🫣). I highly recommend them. I knew my dog ​​was safe and in good hands. Thank you again.
We are regular returning guests with Otis. He comes home after 3-4 days and is asleep within 2 minutes. Dani's are the best.
Thank you for taking care of us! Great place, super cool owners!

Two days before our family trip, our German Shepherd dog had a spinal problem, so we had to find proper care for him because he was completely paralyzed in both back legs. Here they not only welcomed him, but they took care of him 24/7 and even sent us pictures and videos while we were away. We can only recommend them! Our dog was in very good hands!

We were very satisfied with Édenkert Dog Boarding House. They took care of our nearly 50 kg dog until it was sent abroad and we could count on them completely for everything from veterinary examinations and other administrative matters to preparing the dog for the trip. We are completely satisfied with the level of service they provided us with in connection with sending our dog overseas. I definitely recommend them for their conscientious and humane attitude and professionalism.
It was a 5-star experience for us, we can only recommend the place. After 1 week of Dog Boarding, we got back a dog that was just as cheerful and healthy as the one we brought in. :)

I entrusted my little dachshund, Muki, to them for a week, who had never been to a boarding house before. I was a little afraid to leave him in a strange place, with strange people and dogs. However, I saw in the videos they sent that my dog ​​was running around happily after a few days, and he was in good spirits. In addition, due to my inattention, I brought less food for my dog, but Dani and his family solved it without a word and didn't even charge an extra fee for it. ❤️ (And I deserved it 🤭) They are professional, very kind and caring! The placement of the dogs is impeccable. If I am forced to go to a boarding house again next time, I will definitely take my dog ​​to them! Thank you again for the service!

You're good as long as you bring your dog, and then you're a horse.
I brought my dog, my companion Dézi, to him at someone else's suggestion. At first, he was boarding, and then a little later, when a family crisis occurred, housing, pregnancy and the dog's physical well-being were at stake, I decided to trust his services again. We agreed that Dézi, who was six years old at the time, would help teach him so that I could pay the boarding fee and the lessons on top of that. It was already noticeable at that time, and I deeply suspected that the lessons were not only unsuccessful, but also did not happen after a while. I wasted a lot of time and money, I was full of tension and anxiety, because I missed my puppy more than anything, but I was pregnant and had no other choice, no other help.
Several months passed like this, a catharsis developed within our family, my daughter was born prematurely from the shock, she was traumatized that my husband could not accept my puppy and that she had to be away from me.
I had to constantly talk to Dániel about what to do, how Dézi and I should develop our fate, because we are in a very difficult situation. Where we live, grandfather can overfeed her, but there were countless situations where she ran out onto the road, where she could have been hit by a speeding car (a lot of cats ended up like this in front of our house). It was horrible. This worry completely consumed me. I was up day and night because I was breastfeeding the baby, exhausted...
By then I was alone in the new place with my daughter and Dézi was spending more and more time away at the boarding house. Dani and his family, with whom I had a closer relationship and who received the allowance after Dézi, remained convinced after a long time that if they loved Dézi so much and Dézi also loved being there, then they would take her in. (He puts it this way after 4 years: I threw her out)
I still paid and many years passed because of the traumatic loss, because of the resignation, which such an infinitely simple person cannot understand.
Years later, after the death of my second child and my loved ones - carrying the burden of resignation - the family's energy brought it about that we could have a dog together. That's why I approached Dániel to inquire about it, if the dog was boarding, could it go to them. To which his answer at that time was that we shouldn't throw it out like Dézi.
Well, that's what it's all about. A person is not able to remember real events, there is no empathy, acceptance in them - only if you pay a lot while you pay.
But I was certainly the animal abuser, wanting the best place for my dog, not for it to be cut in two by a car due to carelessness, or for it to be overfed by a very old man - my father at the time, out of excessive love, with all kinds of sweets while I nursed you, exhausted... And I could go on and on. And I should even pay for that.
That's why the story wasn't as black and white as Dániel sees it now after a few years. We went out to Dézi a lot, they brought it to us, which we also paid for, until the final decision... And even after.
I don't know what I should have done, after six months? Go there and ask for my puppy back? Would it have been better to pound the table?

But Dániel hasn't been in a difficult situation yet, he hasn't had any serious decisions, but he hasn't brought up a child under such stress. But he's very good at judging in hindsight, when things are no longer going his way.

Everyone should be careful, because after a few years you will be left with nothing, especially if you don't have a dog or any animals.

Very professional place, with a very high experience in managing the dogs, even more problematic ones like my dog. We received regular updates and overall the experience was great. Would definitely recommend to anyone.

Our Mudi dog was declared untreatable without being seen.
Unqualified communication.
I was very satisfied. My 10 year old dog loved it. I recommend it to everyone. The owner is a true dog lover.😍😍😍😍 …
Professional attitude, good environment for dogs
